acquisition_policy: Substack title and any observed embedded YouTube identifier are preserved as first-party source bindings.
A visible Generate transcript interface is not transcript custody; if substantive transcript text is absent, the source remains title/subtitle bounded.
Absence of an observed iframe/video binding is preserved as absence rather than replaced by a guessed adjacent video.
Search-engine snippets are discovery aids and are not transcript custody.
No generated, third-party, or later retrospective transcript may silently replace the original first-party object.
If only partial transcript text becomes available, each extracted proposition must be bounded to the preserved segment and surrounding context status must remain explicit.
A later Randolph statement describing what an earlier video meant is a new source object, not retroactive replacement of the earlier forecast.
